 5-1 in her last 6 matches, Ann Li shoots for a semifinal spot against Lilli Tagger at the WTA 250 Japan Open – Osaka.
 Tagger is coming into the match red-hot after sweeping her first two assignments. However, Li has been on another level over the past two weeks.
 Current Form:
 Lilli Tagger posted back-to-back straight-sets wins to reach the quarterfinals of this WTA 250 event in Osaka. Tagger bested Liudmila Samsonova 6-3, 6-3 and Tereza Valentova 7-5, 6-3 to stay in the hunt for her second WTA title.
 Ann Li blew by Zeynep Sonmez 6-3, 6-1 to clinch her spot in the final eight. Li, the No. 1 seed in this tournament and world No. 25, has won 5 of her last 6 matches, including her quarterfinal run at Wuhan.
 The Matchup: Tagger and Li will meet for the first time on the WTA Tour.

 Our Ann Li vs Lilli Tagger Prediction
 Key Stats: Ann Li is winning 73% of her first-serve points and has dropped only 3 service games in Osaka. She has also generated 23 break chances, converting 10 (43.5%).
 What to Expect: Tagger presents a tough test for Li, but the American wields the form and style to score a convincing win over the Austrian rising star. Li’s flat, penetrating forehands off both wings should take time away from Tagger to execute her heavy-spin shots. Moreover, Li comes off a quarterfinal run at a WTA 1000 event, where she defeated former world No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka in three sets. Tagger is a promising young talent, but she’s not Sabalenka.
 Fearless Forecast: Ann Li wins 6-4, 5-7, 6-3
